user.title: Pella Insynctive
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of the Pella Insynctive bridge.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Pella Insynctive
reconfigure.description: Update the IP address, hostname, or port Home Assistant uses to connect to the Pella Insynctive bridge.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Pella Insynctive connection settings were saved and the integration is reloading. Entities should update within about one minute.

bridge_network.title: Configure Bridge Network
bridge_network.description: Choose whether the bridge should use DHCP or a static IP address. Static IP will show the required network fields on the next screen.

static_network.title: Static IP Settings
static_network.description: Enter all four static network values. Saving will write the settings to the bridge, save them to memory, reboot the bridge, update Home Assistant to the new static IP, and reload the integration.

dhcp_confirm.title: Return Bridge to DHCP
dhcp_confirm.description: This will remove static IP settings from the bridge, return it to DHCP mode, and reboot the bridge. If DHCP assigns a different IP address, use Reconfigure afterward to point Home Assistant to the new address.

data.confirm_dhcp: I understand and want to switch the bridge to DHCP

error.bridge_not_loaded: The Pella Insynctive bridge is not currently loaded.
error.cannot_set_static_network: Could not write static network settings to the bridge. Check the values and bridge connection, then try again.
error.cannot_set_dhcp: Could not switch the bridge to DHCP. Check the bridge connection and try again.
error.confirm_required: Confirm before switching the bridge to DHCP.
